cohort: 7 women under 30 years old with suspected placenta accreta spectrum
finding: Hysterectomy after cesarean section is the preferred treatment for placenta increta or percreta, but it carries a high risk of complications, particularly damage to the urinary system, which can be mitigated by preoperative placement of ureteral catheters.
mod_finding: The study recommends cesarean section at 34-36 weeks of pregnancy for patients diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum and suggests hysterectomy as the preferred treatment method for placenta increta or percreta.
